title: Professor Carver’s Crashed Sidewinder
excerpt: A Crash Site can be found in the HIP 69200 system, on body 1 b, The crashed Sidewinder forms part of the Adamastor storyline. There is a data core to scan for a message (with audio), and some cargo canisters lying around the crash. The Sidewinder was taken from the megaship Adamastor by Professor Carver…
